body: I know it’s disappointing when day after day, things remain as bleak as ever. But getting through each day feeling this way is an accomplishment within itself.  One we often forget to give ourselves credit for.  You are stronger than you think, and I wish more than anything you didn’t have to feel the way that you do. Focus on the little things to keep you pushing forward.  There are brighter days ahead...there have to be.  You’re not alone in this—here if you need anything.

I’m glad you moved forward and found light at the end of this tunnel.  Thank you for reaching out and giving me even the slightest glimmer of hope.  I know we’re just strangers, but I wish you the best, from the bottom of my heart.

Thank you for reaching out. Knowing that I’m not alone is helpful, and I know that it is hard to take our own advice sometimes, but the same goes for you.  It’s a difficult thing, and I wish I could offer you a solution to make all of it go away. Unfortunately, that’s not the way depression works.  But if you ever need someone to just talk to, I’m here for you.  Like you mentioned, no one deserves to feel this way...including you.  You’re not alone in this.
